system.description:
Your speed bewilders even other supernaturally swift creatures, your passage plucking falling objects from the air.

By expending a Blood Trait, in addition to the benefits of Swiftness, you may use the Bomb in challenges that depend on speed or agility (never on strength). You must warn your opponent that you can use the Bomb, and how it works, before the challenge; the Bomb defeats Rock and Paper, loses to Scissors, and ties other Bombs. You may — but are never required to — use the Bomb in any speed challenge throughout the turn. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, and a surprised character cannot use Celerity on the first challenge. The effect lasts one turn.
